title: Equil - connect timeout
body:
[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30615742/AndroidAPS.log)

In version 3.2.4.5, when attempting to perform a bolus, even through the calculator, there is no connection. The timer counts down, but no insulin is delivered. The log is on. The same situation occurs when attempting to change the reservoir.

comments.body:
I cannot reproduce this issue. It seems to be specific to your phone/android stack
Anyway, I changed the scanning mode to try to address your specific issue
Build from dev3 branch, test and report here
@mspiechowicz-oss

> I cannot reproduce this issue. It seems to be specific to your phone/android stack Anyway, I changed the scanning mode to try to address your specific issue Build from dev3 branch, test and report here [@mspiechowicz-oss](https://github.com/mspiechowicz-oss)

Building dev3. Everything works fine on version 3.2.4.2. Newer versions have this exact same issue. It's not just me, as many users on the Polish Equil Facebook group are having this problem.

@MilosKozak The bolus is working properly. Changing the reservoir doesn't work. The plunger retracts, but then the reservoir can't be filled.

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30620738/AndroidAPS.log)

@MilosKozak nothing changed. Something that appeared between 3.4.2.2 and 3.4.2.3 is causing the problem.

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30628133/AndroidAPS.log)
seems to be old version. must be 03ea9f72f5ef45dc8e9d1fef9e5213df6180f9f8 @mspiechowicz-oss
@MilosKozak Hmm, what am I missing? I've synced the branches in my fork, even deleted the branch and added it again, and I always get this dev3 version.
go to dev3 branch on your github and press sync
I think I got it. It seems to work on this version. [AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30630074/AndroidAPS.log)
@MilosKozak bolus works, changing the insulin reservoir works. You're the best ;)
